scope: Numerical mathematics, selected algorithms, actual public API/output contracts and linear solver settings. No native build or new benchmark performed for this review.

checks.item: DOPRI5 tableau and nonlinear order proof
checks.evidence: 17 exact endpoint rooted-tree conditions through order five and 8 embedded conditions through order four in analysis/NUMERICS_CHECK.json; c=A*1 verified.
Same immutable provider, registered schedule and full transition state explicitly required; exact cached endpoint derivative follows last-row tableau identity.
Exact stability polynomial, contractivity for absolute phase increment <=0.9, Taylor remainder and variable-step telescoping bound verified; nonlinear/nonnormal extrapolation excluded.
Eight stages; Gamma=(gamma^-1 I-C)^-1, alpha=A Gamma, g=Gamma*1 match coefficients.rs. Equations13–17 algebraically equivalent in exact arithmetic.
Residual now defined against approximate prior-stage RHS; nonnegative triangular propagation Q is nilpotent of degree8; endpoint weighting bound valid.

Routing default: restart40,totalArnoldi200,zero initial guess,no preconditioner. Raw-U absolute residual budget is downward-rounded |gamma|*1e-14, relative budget1e-10 times raw-U RHS2norm; maximum criterion matches gmres_into/common.
Uniform exact-flow Lipschitz and numerical local-defect assumptions stated on common neighborhood including computed states; local tolerance not represented as global certificate.
Quartic DOPRI samples, transformed RODAS quartic polynomial and W-filtered midpoint defect correspond to source; no interior global certificate claimed.

General selector refuses mass/events/dense; explicit sampled output distinguished from retained interpolant; RODAS public arbitrary landing schedule not claimed; JVP vector atol and dense output separately refused.

No BASS/rei-specific modeling, internal DAG/claim-gate status, candidate development history or timing benchmark results. References retain original paper titles. Methods and direct output extensions are the selected DOPRI5/RODAS5P families.

limitations: This is a bounded specification review, not an unrestricted production qualification or security review.
No independent proof of all nonlinear RODAS order conditions from rounded decimal literals is asserted.
The stated classical order, exact arithmetic identities and observed floating-point tests must remain distinct.
Final PDF rendering/layout is handled by the document writer, not assessed in this numerical review.
Published references are checked for method relevance; this review does not reproduce their full proofs.
